definitions.full: H4544. miskenuth מִסְכֵּנֻת noun feminine poverty, scarcity , Deut 8:9 . מִסְכְּנוֺת see I. סכן . מַסְלוּל מְסִלָּה, see סלל . [ מִסְמֵר ], מַסְמְרִים etc. see סמר ( שׂמר ).

occurrences.englishText: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
